text.text_excerpt: I booked this hotel through Groupon and the check in process was a breeze. My younger brother and sister were visiting New Orleans so we decided to have a little staycation at The Mercantile. The room we were offered initially was very dark and the window view was literally a brick wall. This wasn't really the vibe I wanted to go for, considering I booked this place over others for the awesome bright rooms and views I saw online. I went back to the check in desk and Anitra (I believe that's her name) was so kind and helpful. She asked if the room was what I expected and quickly searched to find another room available for the night. We were switched to an awesome, bright room and settled i...

I was in New Orleans for my Nephew's Wedding and was lucky enough to get a really good rate at the Mercantile Hotel. Located in the Warehouse District near to the Casino and the Convention Center the location was very good. There are plenty of restaurants and bars nearby; the French Quarter is about 1/2 mile away. Mercantile's is a converted Sugar Factory and the decor reflects this. The lobby is small but comfortable. The rooms are all suites; you get a bedroom, bathroom and a sitting room with a sleeper couch, chair and a desk. There is a large flat screen TV in the sitting room and a slightly smaller one in the bedroom. The closet has a programmable safe, ironing board and an iron. A g...

We were hotel hopping the weekend of New Years eve and had a fantastic night at The Mercantile Hotel. Front desk was very friendly in checking us in, even though we came a couple hours ahead of the check in time. Valet was full, so you may want to keep that in mind for really busy weekends such as New years Eve/Sugar Bowl weekends like our stay. The valet fee was going to be $42 a night, which is rough but space is a commodity in the Warehouse/CBD area. You could always park your car somewhere uptown on a good looking street and uber back to the hotel and risk it? The Location of the hotel is great.
